# CI tooling only. Nothing here is a runtime dependency: the plugin imports the standard library and
# nothing else, which a step in the `checks` job enforces. This file exists so the pin is a file
# dependabot can see and bump in a PR, rather than a literal buried in a run step that goes stale
# quietly.
#
# The stdlib-only rule is about `plugin/lib`, which the hooks import with whatever `python3` the
# machine has and no chance to install anything. It does not reach a CI step that has already run
# pip, which is why the `needs` check in `ci` can parse the workflow properly instead of with a regex
# that would agree with a file Actions rejects.
ruff==0.16.9
pyyaml==6.0.3
